name: Admin Proposal — Adjuntar desde Documentos
description: From the Correos tab of the proposal edit page, admin clicks 'Adjuntar desde Documentos'. A modal opens listing all available documents: contract PDF + draft (if contract exists), commercial PDF, technical PDF, and any uploaded proposal_documents. Admin selects one or more items and clicks 'Adjuntar (N)'. Selected refs appear as emerald badges below the attachments block. On send, the POST body includes a doc_refs JSON field with the resolved refs. Sending is handled by admin-send-branded-email / admin-send-proposal-email; this flow covers only the selection UX.
